sentences.text: Mr. Anshul R. Shrivastava, counsel for the petitioner.
Mr. Keshav Prasad Gupta, Govt. Advocate for the State.
Learned counsel for the State seeks further two weeks time to file reply.
Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the issue is very limited and since December 2022 time was granted to file reply.

As the case is based on legal submission of Section 60 (1)
(f) of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013, the case may be listed at the earliest.
